intro.text:
A column of water is held against the left wall of a tank. Then the dam is removed.

Blue is water, dark is air.

outro.text:
The free surface is tracked with the Volume of Fluid method: each cell stores how full of water it is.

OpenFOAM interFoam · 2D laminar

captions.text: Gravity pulls the column down, and the water starts to spread across the floor.
The front races along the bottom of the tank.
At about 0.3 s it hits the right wall and shoots up it as a thin jet.
The jet almost reaches the top of the tank, then falls back and folds over, trapping air.
The water keeps sloshing back and forth as it settles.
